description: Source code implementing a class and function to break variable aliasing in inner loops for shader compiler optimization, specifically targeting the ANGLE project.

classes.name: AliasingBreaker
classes.description: A traverser class that modifies assignment nodes within nested loops to break aliasing chains by adding zero to the right-hand side of assignments.

methods.name: BreakVariableAliasingInInnerLoops
methods.description: Main function that applies the aliasing breaker to the AST and validates the modified AST.
